title: Run an AI-native consultancy
description: Win clients from signals, turn calls into proposals, and report progress and hours without the Friday afternoon scramble.

navigation.title: Consulting & Agency
navigation.tagline: Winning clients, proposals, reporting, and time

introduction: Consultants and agencies sell, deliver, and report, usually for five clients at once. The client work is the fun part. The admin around it is where the week goes.
Strawberry works across your inbox, calendar, client tools, and the web, and keeps each client's context separate. It can take care of most of the admin, so the hours go to the work clients pay for.

blocks.text: Not sure where to start? Your companion can look at the work you have open and suggest the first thing worth handing over.

skill.context: Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing to hand over.

blocks.text: Companies that just raised a round, posted a relevant job, or launched something new are often ready to buy. Strawberry finds them in your area or niche and drafts a short one-pager for each on how you could help.

items.context: Find companies showing the signals that make them good clients right now.

sections.title: Turn a call into a proposal

blocks.text: Record the discovery call without a bot, and Strawberry drafts the proposal from what was said and your best past proposals. You edit instead of starting from a blank page.
Strawberry pulls from project boards, analytics, ad accounts, and meeting notes to build each client's report in the format they're used to. One client first, then the rest.
Strawberry pieces together hours from calendars, recordings, and project tools into a weekly report per client, ready for you to check before invoicing.

sections.title: Walk into kickoff knowing the client

blocks.text: Their business, their market, their competitors, and the people in the room, researched before the first meeting.

items: Turn research into a client-ready deck.
Run an SEO audit on a client's site.
Find candidates when the firm is hiring.

blocks.text: Each client gets its own context, and nothing leaks between them. Save your way of scoping, proposing, and reporting as team skills, and every consultant on the team works to the same standard.
Put reports and time summaries on Routines, and Friday afternoons get a lot quieter.
